title: Word Streak Duels
oneLiner: Daily word ladders vs friends — beat their streak, share your best chain, back tomorrow for the next ladder.
inspiredBy: Words With Friends-style social word play
targetAudience: Casual FB players 18–44 who open Messenger/Gaming Tab for 2–5 minute sessions; enjoy light word puzzles and friend competition more than deep strategy.

pillars.coreLoop: See 5 letters → make the longest valid chain in 60s → post score to context
pillars.social: Challenge friend with your seed word; async rematch; group leaderboard
pillars.retention: Daily ladder seed + streak freeze (rewarded ad) + weekly themed packs
pillars.monetization: Rewarded ad for hint / streak freeze; light IAP for cosmetic tiles + extra daily ladder
pillars.discovery: Bold letter-tile icon; cover shows two friends racing a word chain
pillars.liveOps: Theme weeks (sports, movies), limited ladders, seasonal dictionaries
